page.layout: Two parallel columns of index entries, left column then right column, each entry with its page numbers at the line end. Running head "INDEX." at the top. No page number, catchword or signature printed.

page.notes: The page is a printed index. Its entries are split across lines in the scan, so the joining of wrapped entries is my reading of the layout. Some words in the last lines of each column are close to illegible and may be misread: "Pari-" and "Mincius" in particular, plus the number "38" after "ficta" and the entry "Michael imp.Constantinopolitanus". The final "missa" is cut off at the foot of the page. No marginal notes.
